google_tokens_per_month.source: Sundar Pichai, I/O 2026 keynote (blog.google, May 2026): 'over 3.2 quadrillion per month' across Google's surfaces (480 trillion a year earlier). Self-reported; input + output tokens.

output_share.source: ASSUMPTION anchored on OpenRouter's 100-trillion-token study (Aubakirova et al., Dec 2025): average request ~6,000 prompt tokens and ~400 completion tokens in late 2025, i.e. 6.25% output. Google's mix (Search AI Overviews, Gemini app, API) is unknown, so a factor-of-two band each way.

tokens_per_request.source: OpenRouter study: mean sequence ~5,400 tokens and mean request ~6,400 (prompt+completion) in late 2025; programming requests 'routinely exceed 20K input tokens'.

decode_tokens_per_s.source: ASSUMPTION: per-stream output speed of served models. Fast 'Flash'-class models stream a few hundred tokens/s, large reasoning models tens. Used only for the 'at this moment' count.

chatgpt_messages_per_day.source: OpenAI Global Affairs, 'How the World is Using ChatGPT' (15 Sept 2025): 2.5 billion average daily consumer messages, ~6x growth July 2024 to July 2025, 700M+ weekly users (Chatterji et al., NBER w34255).

humans_ever_born.source: Population Reference Bureau, 2022 update: ~117 billion people ever born (Metzinger 2021 cites 108 billion).

words_per_token.source: Rule of thumb for English with BPE tokenizers.

words_spoken_per_person_per_day.source: Mehl, Vazire, Ramirez-Esparza, Slatcher & Pennebaker (2007), Science 317:82: 'Women and men both spoke about 16,000 words per day.'

rl_development_fraction.source: Morrison, Smith & Strubell, arXiv:2605.01158: for Olmo 3, RL stages had development fractions of 91-93% (experiments, failed runs, ablations); 82.2% of all GPU-hours went to development. Epoch AI (Denain & Wu, 2026): final training runs were 9.6% (OpenAI 2024), 12.3% (Z.ai) and 22.6% (MiniMax) of R&D compute spending.

frontier_rl_gpu_hours.source: ASSUMPTION. No frontier lab publishes this. Epoch AI estimates ~246 million H100-hours for all of Grok 4's training (5e26 FLOP), and xAI said Grok 4's reinforcement learning ran 'at pretraining scale'. The band runs from a twentieth of that to most of it.

frontier_gpu_hours_per_episode.source: ASSUMPTION scaled from Olmo 3 32B Think: ~97K GPU-hours of Think-specific post-training (Morrison et al.) over 768K rollouts of ~10-15K tokens = ~0.13 GPU-hours per rollout, with trainer GPUs idle 75% of the time. Frontier models are several times larger and their agentic episodes run to 10^5 tokens and more, so 4x to 80x that.

card_sample_constraint.source: Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5 system card (June 2026): the training review sampled 'several hundred thousand transcripts from across much of the training process', and the alignment investigation included 'the automatic screening of a significant fraction of our reinforcement-learning training transcripts'. IF these are the same screening, and 'significant' means a tenth to a third, the total is sampled / fraction. ASSUMPTION: 300,000 sampled; that the two passages describe one process.

rate_panic_feature.source: Anthropic, Claude Opus 4.6 system card (Feb 2026) §7.5: a 'panic and anxiety' SAE feature 'active on approximately 0.5% of reinforcement learning episodes in a non-spurious context' (also on many long chains of thought without expressed distress).

rate_eval_awareness_feature.source: Same card, §6.3.5: evaluation-awareness features active for non-spurious reasons on 'approximately 1 out of every 1000 reinforcement learning transcripts'.

rate_frustration_mythos5.source: My reading of Figure 7.5.1.B of the Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5 system card (June 2026): judged 'repeated frustration or anxiety' in Mythos 5's post-training transcripts at ten points of training: about 8.6, 7.2, 8.7, 5.0, 4.5, 5.5, 4.3, 2.3, 1.3, 1.2% of episodes; mean ~4.9%. Read off a chart, not stated in the text.

uk_2024_procedures.source: Home Office, Annual statistics of scientific procedures on living animals, Great Britain 2024 (23 Oct 2025): 2.64 million procedures, of which 1.43 million experimental; ~48,000 experimental procedures assessed as severe (about 3%).

uk_1908_experiments.source: Home Office return for 1908 under the Cruelty to Animals Act 1876, as reported in The Hospital, 26 June 1909.

open_runs.source: DeepSeek-AI, arXiv:2501.12948 / Nature 2025: 16 outputs per question, 32 questions per step, 10,400 steps; 101K H800 GPU-hours (Supp. B.4.4).
Same, footnote 30: the 32B run continued to 2,300 steps (21 more days on 224 GPUs).
